summary: A dispatched worker lane holds no Concord read or write tool access, and the dispatch packet is its complete Concord context. Lane and utility definitions deny every concord_* tool from the derived surface list, the adapter refuses a managed-parent call with a structured no-effect envelope before the core runs, the lane text states the packet is complete, and the law context carries the Domain registry path so a lane reads Domain structure from the repository file. Extends CD-0017 D4.
title: Worker lanes hold no Concord tool access, and the dispatch packet is their complete Concord context
